There was a European woman and a Black woman who both spoke to the principal about their children being bullied. The European woman yelled at the principal for the lack of help the school was providing, while the Black woman asked what could be done to improve the situation. Which person spoke calmly to the principal?
A. The Black woman
B. The European woman
C. Not known
